extractor.reads: theorem values inside an evaluation-only source process

component_policy.edge: dependent theorem to a directly used theorem when both names are candidates
component_policy.component: weakly connected component of the induced directed graph
component_policy.split_rule: assign a whole component to exactly one future split
component_policy.family_rule: component integrity overrides theme and module quotas
component_policy.cycle_rule: reject a cycle rather than silently condense it
component_policy.non_claim: dependency metadata does not reveal an Axeyum route, outcome, proof plan, or construction

isolation_policy.allowed_consumers: offline component derivation and leakage audit
isolation_policy.forbidden_consumers: proposers, proof search, route selection, and episode workers
isolation_policy.durable_projection: candidate names, direct candidate edges, and component membership only
